title: Count the vowels
description: Write a function `count_vowels(text)` that returns how many characters in `text` are vowels (a, e, i, o, u — lowercase only, you can assume the input is already lowercase).
hints: Strings can be looped over directly, character by character.
Keep a counter, and check membership: is the current character one of 'aeiou'?
expected_behavior: Returns an integer count of vowels.
explanation: A `for` loop over a string yields one character at a time. The `in` operator checks membership in the vowel string, so the counter only increases for matching characters.
